```sql
WITH active_dept_manager AS (
    SELECT emp_no, dept_no
    FROM dept_manager
    WHERE from_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND to_date > CURRENT_DATE()
),
active_departments AS (
    SELECT d.dept_no, d.dept_name
    FROM departments d
    JOIN active_dept_manager dm ON d.dept_no = dm.dept_no
),
reporting_employees AS (
    SELECT de.dept_no, COUNT(DISTINCT de.emp_no) AS emp_count
    FROM dept_emp de
    WHERE de.from_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND de.to_date > CURRENT_DATE()
    GROUP BY de.dept_no
)
SELECT 
    dm.emp_no AS manager_id, 
    e.first_name, 
    e.last_name, 
    d.dept_name, 
    COALESCE(re.emp_count, 0) AS reporting_employees
FROM active_dept_manager dm
JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = dm.emp_no
JOIN active_departments d ON d.dept_no = dm.dept_no
LEFT JOIN reporting_employees re ON re.dept_no = dm.dept_no
ORDER BY reporting_employees DESC, dm.emp_no ASC 
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
WITH active_managers AS (
    SELECT emp_no, dept_no
    FROM dept_manager
    WHERE from_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND to_date > CURRENT_DATE()
),
active_departments AS (
    SELECT dept_no, dept_name
    FROM departments
),
reporting_employees AS (
    SELECT de.dept_no, de.emp_no
    FROM dept_emp de
    WHERE de.from_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND de.to_date > CURRENT_DATE()
)
SELECT 
    dm.emp_no AS manager_id, 
    e.first_name, 
    e.last_name, 
    d.dept_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.emp_no) AS reporting_employees 
FROM 
    active_managers dm 
JOIN 
    employees e ON e.emp_no = dm.emp_no 
JOIN 
    active_departments d ON d.dept_no = dm.dept_no 
LEFT JOIN 
    reporting_employees re ON re.dept_no = dm.dept_no AND re.emp_no <> dm.emp_no 
GROUP BY 
    dm.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.dept_name 
ORDER BY 
    reporting_employees DESC, dm.emp_no ASC 
LIMIT 10;
```
